templates.technical_text: Apply the vendor-supplied security patch immediately. Verify the patch is applied correctly by running a vulnerability scan. If a patch is not available, implement vendor-recommended workarounds.
Update the affected software to the latest patched version. Restart the service after the update. Validate that the vulnerability is no longer present using security scanning tools.
Review the configuration settings and apply the recommended secure configuration baseline. Use configuration management tools to enforce the correct settings and prevent drift.

Add the missing security headers to your web server configuration. Include Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Strict-Transport-Security. Test the headers using online header checkers.
Upgrade the software to the latest version available. Review the release notes for any breaking changes and test in a staging environment before deploying to production.
Review the finding and assess its relevance. Follow standard security remediation procedures: identify root cause, apply fix, verify resolution, and document the change.
Replace weak cryptographic algorithms with stronger alternatives. Use industry-standard protocols (TLS 1.2+, AES-256, RSA-2048). Rotate any exposed keys or certificates.
Revoke the exposed credentials immediately. Generate new strong credentials and rotate them across all affected systems. Implement secret management solutions to prevent future exposure.
Review and enforce least privilege access policies. Remove unnecessary permissions and implement role-based access control (RBAC). Audit all IAM configurations regularly.

Activate incident response procedures. Isolate affected systems, preserve evidence for forensics, notify security team and legal/compliance. Engage external forensic experts if required. Follow breach notification timelines.
Apply the security update. If the update is not available, implement network controls such as access restrictions or Web Application Firewall rules to mitigate the risk.

fallback.technical_text: Investigate the finding and apply appropriate security controls. Consult the vendor documentation for guidance. If unsure, escalate to the security team.
